title: Leaderboard Restore
summary: The leaderboard is reading new-version runs correctly again.

categories.name: Fixed
items: Completed runs now appear correctly on the leaderboard.

title: A Fresh Leaderboard
summary: The leaderboard now starts fresh whenever the game rules change, while every past run remains part of your grove's history.

categories.name: Leaderboard
items: Scores now compete only against runs played on the current game version.
Past runs are safely kept for future profile history.

title: A Sharper Last Stand
summary: Guardian balance, clearer onboarding, and a better way to keep up with every update.

categories.name: Quality of life
items: Returning players now get a What's New summary once per release.
Release notes can be reopened anytime and previewed safely before publishing.

categories.name: Balance
items: Boarstone attacks hit harder and cover more ground, but fire more slowly.
Selling a guardian now returns 75% of all gold invested.

categories.name: Changed
items: Guardians can no longer be moved after they are planted.
The guided intro now ends with a clear, always-visible Got it action.
